newsitem.title: FINLAND: Metra sees improving full-year profit.
newsitem.headline: Metra sees improving full-year profit.

text.p: Finnish diversified engineering group Oy Metra Ab said on Wednesday it expected full-year 1997 profit after financial items to improve over last year and that group net sales would rise to 15 bilion markka.

"Eliminating the impact of non-recurring items, the recurring profit after net financial items is predicted to improve on the previous year," Metra said in a statement with its four-month results. The 1996 profit was 894 million markka.
"Metra's net sales are expected to reach 15 billion markka," it said. Last year, consolidated net sales totalled 11.7 billion markka.
Thanks to a strong orderbook, Metra said full-year net sales of its Wartsila New Sulzer Diesel division were expected to exceed 11 billion markka compared to eight billion in 1996.
Operating profitability would remain on a par with the 1996 level, it said. Last year, Wartsila's operating profit was four percent of the division's net sales.

Metra said its bathroom ceramics unit Sanitec's 1997 net sales were forecast to reach almost three billion markka, up from 2.7 billion in 1996, and profitability to equal that of last year (13.1 percent of division net sales in 1996). @
Imatra Steel's net sales and profitability should stay at their 1996 levels, Metra said, referring to the division's 925 million markka sales and 102 million markka operating profit.
